errors.text_span: които са изписани вътре в секторите или външно с линии, свързващи ги със съответните области
errors.evidence: The description states that labels are written inside or outside the sectors, but all labels are located externally and are connected to their respective sectors with lines.
The description incorrectly refers to the numerical values as percentages ('проценти'). The labels show absolute integer values (4, 4, 4, 4, 1).

errors.text_span: са изписани директно вътре в секторите или външно
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the previous error. The description incorrectly states that labels are written inside or outside the sectors, when in fact all labels are external.
